# GCP auth

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Authenticate to Google Cloud via Workload Identity Federation or an SA key

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/gcp-auth@v1
```

## How it works

Authenticate to Google Cloud, Workload Identity Federation first.

WIF is the GCP equivalent of AWS OIDC: the job's GitHub identity token is exchanged for a
short-lived GCP access token, so no service-account JSON key ever lives in the repo.
Needs `permissions: id-token: write` and a workload identity provider whose attribute
condition pins `assertion.repository` to this repo — see docs/SECURITY.md.

Service-account JSON keys remain supported (some GCP APIs and older tooling still need
one), but the action warns, because an exported SA key is a permanent credential in a
secret store.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workload-identity-provider` | no | `""` | Full WIF provider resource name (`projects/N/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/P/providers/R`). |
| `service-account` | no | `""` | Service account email to impersonate via WIF. |
| `credentials-json` | no | `""` | Service-account JSON key. Only used when no WIF provider is set. |
| `project-id` | no | `""` | Project to set as the active gcloud project. |
| `setup-gcloud` | no | `true` | true to install the gcloud CLI as well as authenticating. |
| `gcloud-components` | no | `""` | Comma-separated extra gcloud components, e.g. `beta,gke-gcloud-auth-plugin`. |
| `docker-registries` | no | `""` | Comma-separated Artifact Registry / GCR hosts to configure Docker for, e.g. `us-central1-docker.pkg.dev,gcr.io`. Empty skips Docker configuration. |
| `token-format` | no | `access_token` | `access_token` (default) or `id_token`. `id_token` is for calling Cloud Run/IAP. |
| `id-token-audience` | no | `""` | Audience for `id_token` format. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `project-id` | The resolved project ID. |
| `access-token` | Short-lived OAuth access token. Treat as a secret. |
| `id-token` | OIDC ID token, when `token-format` is `id_token`. |
